limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter’s handshake condition but also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` on `valid_a`, whereas the reference preserves registered readiness and asserts `valid_b` whenever the pre-edge count is five.
The test expected the rewrite’s behavior—high readiness during reset and a valid pulse only on sixth-bit acceptance—so it passed despite the reset and output-timing regressions.
